name: Alvimopan
aliases: alvimopan anhydrous, ADL 8-2698, Alvimopan anhydrous, Anhydrous alvimopan, Entereg®
summary: Alvimopan (trade name Entereg) is a drug which behaves as a peripherally acting μ-opioid receptor antagonist.

pharmacology.text: Alvimopan is a competitive antagonist of the μ-opioid receptors (MOR) in the gastrointestinal tract, with a Ki of 0.2 ng/mL. Activation of these receptors by endogenous or exogenous agonists reduces gastrointestinal motility, and alvimopan blocks this effect.

body.says: Gut microflora-mediated hydrolysis to active metabolite

uses.text: Alvimopan is indicated in people to avoid postoperative ileus following partial large or small bowel resection with primary anastomosis. Alvimopan accelerates the gastrointestinal recovery period as defined by time to first bowel movement or flatus.

summaryZh: 阿維莫泮（INN：英語：Alvimopan）是一種周邊作用型μ-阿片受體拮抗劑的藥物。由於它會穿越血腦屏障並到達中樞神經系統中μ-阿片受體的能力有限，因此可避免中樞作用型類阿片拮抗劑所產生的臨床不良反應（如：逆轉阿片類藥物媒介的止痛作用），同時仍能有效阻斷胃腸道中的μ-阿片受體。
